parent_lock.project: TPC-319 Ky Fan cluster normalization firewall

protocol.error_model: safe |K|<=160, dual-path solver spread, residual, and finite Weyl quotient guard; numerical only
protocol.matrix_entry: 1_{t!=u,p not_divides ut} p H^(2s)/(H^2+(u-t)^2)^s (1_{u==t mod p}-1/(p-1))
protocol.spectral_method: SciPy symmetric top-17 eigensolver plus NumPy full eigvalsh on forward and reverse shell accumulations
protocol.trace_normalization: C_k=F_k/tr(G), p_j=lambda_j/tr(G), independent of global positive scalar
